chapterInfo.content:
11
Adansefoɔ baanu no
1 # Hes 40.3; Sak 2.1-2 Na wɔmaa me demmire a ɛte sɛ abaa kaa sɛ: Sɔre na susu Nyankopɔn asɔredan ne afɔrebukyia ne wɔn a wɔsɔre wɔ mu no. 2#Luka 21.24; Adi 11.3; 12.6; 12.14; 13.5 Na adihɔ a ɛwɔ asɔredan no ho no deɛ, gya to hɔ, na nsusu, ɛfiri sɛ wɔde ama amanaman mufoɔ, na wɔbɛtiatia kuro kronkron no so abosome aduanan mmienu. 3#Adi 11.2 Na mɛma m’adansefoɔ baanu afirafira ayitoma abɛka adiyisɛm nna apem ahanu aduosia.
4 # Sak 4.3; 4.11-14 Yeinom ne ngodua mmienu ne akaneadua mmienu a ɛgyinagyina asase wura anim no. 5#2 Ah 1.10 Na sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔha wɔn a, ogya firi wɔn anomu bɛmene wɔn atamfoɔ, na sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔha wɔn a, ɛtwa sɛ wɔku no saa ara. 6#1 Ah 17.1; Eks 7.19-20 Yeinom wɔ tumi sɛ wɔto ɔsoro mu, na osuo ntɔ wɔn adiyie nna no mu, na wɔwɔ nsuo so tumi sɛ wɔma no dane mogya ne sɛ wɔde haw biara ha asase da biara a wɔpɛ.
7 # Adi 13.1; 13.7; 17.8 Na sɛ wɔwie wɔn adansedie a, aboa a ɔfiri ebunu no mu no bɛtu wɔn so sa, na wadi wɔn so nkonim na wɔaku wɔn. 8#Adi 16.19; Yes 1.9-10; Luka 13.34 Na wɔn afunu bɛdeda kuro kɛseɛ no abɔntene so, kuro a honhom mu wɔfrɛ no Sodom ne Misraim, deɛ wɔbɔɔ wɔn Awurade nso asɛnnua mu no. 9Na nkurɔfoɔ ne mmusuakuo ne kasa ahodoɔ ne aman mu binom bɛhwɛ wɔn afunu nnansa ne fa, na wɔremma wɔmfa wɔn afunu no ntoto ɛda mu. 10Na wɔn a wɔtete asase soɔ ani bɛgye wɔn ho, na wɔn bo atɔ wɔn yamu, na wɔamanemane wɔn ho adeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ adiyifoɔ baanu yi ateetee wɔn a wɔte asase soɔ.
11Na nnansa ne fa akyiri no, nkwa honhom firii Nyankopɔn mu bɛhyɛnee wɔn mu, na wɔgyinagyinaa wɔn nan so, na ehu kɛseɛ kaa wɔn a wɔhunuu wɔn no. 12#2 Ah 2.11 Na wɔtee nne kɛseɛ bi firi soro a ɛka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Momforo mmra ha! Na wɔforo faa mununkum no mu, na wɔn atamfoɔ no hunuu wɔn. 13Na ɛdɔn no ara mu asase wosoo kɛse, na kuro no nkyekyɛmu du mu baako hwee ase, na asasewosoɔ no kumm nnipa mpemnson. Na wɔn a ɛkaeɛ no suroe, na wɔhyɛɛ ɔsoro Nyankopɔn animuonyam. 14#Adi 9.12; 11.15; 12.12 Mmusuo a ɛtɔ so mmienu no atwa mu. Hwɛ, Mmusuo a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa reba ntɛm.
15 # Dan 2.44; 7.27; Sak 14.9 Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nson no hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto. Na ɛnne akɛseɛ gyegyegyegyee soro sɛ:
Wiase ahennie ayɛ yɛn Awurade
ne ne Kristo no dea,
na ɔbɛdi hene daa daa.
16 # Adi 4.4; 4.10; 7.11 Na mpanimfoɔ aduonu nnan a wɔtete wɔn nhennwa soɔ Nyankopɔn anim no de wɔn anim butubutuu fam, na wɔkotoo Onyankopɔn 17#Adi 4.8 kaa sɛ:
Yɛda wo, Awurade Nyankopɔn, ade nyinaa so Tumfoɔ
a na wowɔ hɔ dada, na wowɔ hɔ no ase,
sɛ woafa wo tumi kɛseɛ,
na woadi hene.
18 # Adi 15.1; Dwom 2.1; 2.5; 2.12 Na amanaman no bo afu,
na w’abufuo ne awufoɔ berɛ no
aduru sɛ wobɛbu atɛn,
na woama wo nkoa, adiyifoɔ
ne ahotefoɔ ne wɔn a wɔsuro wo din,
nketewa ne akɛseɛ no akatua,
na woasɛe wɔn a wɔasɛe asase no.
19 # Adi 15.5; 4.5 Na wɔhinii Nyankopɔn asɔredan no ɔsoro, na wɔhunuu n’apam adaka no n’asɔredan no mu. Na anyinam, ne ɛnne, ne aprannaa, ne asasewosoɔ ne asukɔtweaaguo kɛseɛ bae.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na wɔmaa me demmire a ɛte sɛ abaa kaa sɛ: Sɔre na susu Nyankopɔn asɔredan ne afɔrebukyia ne wɔn a wɔsɔre wɔ mu no. Na adihɔ a ɛwɔ asɔredan no ho no deɛ, gya to hɔ, na nsusu, ɛfiri sɛ wɔde ama amanaman mufoɔ, na wɔbɛtiatia kuro kronkron no so abosome aduanan mmienu. Na mɛma m’adansefoɔ baanu afirafira ayitoma abɛka adiyisɛm nna apem ahanu aduosia.
Yeinom ne ngodua mmienu ne akaneadua mmienu a ɛgyinagyina asase wura anim no. Na sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔha wɔn a, ogya firi wɔn anomu bɛmene wɔn atamfoɔ, na sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔha wɔn a, ɛtwa sɛ wɔku no saa ara. Yeinom wɔ tumi sɛ wɔto ɔsoro mu, na osuo ntɔ wɔn adiyie nna no mu, na wɔwɔ nsuo so tumi sɛ wɔma no dane mogya ne sɛ wɔde haw biara ha asase da biara a wɔpɛ.
Na sɛ wɔwie wɔn adansedie a, aboa a ɔfiri ebunu no mu no bɛtu wɔn so sa, na wadi wɔn so nkonim na wɔaku wɔn. Na wɔn afunu bɛdeda kuro kɛseɛ no abɔntene so, kuro a honhom mu wɔfrɛ no Sodom ne Misraim, deɛ wɔbɔɔ wɔn Awurade nso asɛnnua mu no. Na nkurɔfoɔ ne mmusuakuo ne kasa ahodoɔ ne aman mu binom bɛhwɛ wɔn afunu nnansa ne fa, na wɔremma wɔmfa wɔn afunu no ntoto ɛda mu. Na wɔn a wɔtete asase soɔ ani bɛgye wɔn ho, na wɔn bo atɔ wɔn yamu, na wɔamanemane wɔn ho adeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ adiyifoɔ baanu yi ateetee wɔn a wɔte asase soɔ.
Na nnansa ne fa akyiri no, nkwa honhom firii Nyankopɔn mu bɛhyɛnee wɔn mu, na wɔgyinagyinaa wɔn nan so, na ehu kɛseɛ kaa wɔn a wɔhunuu wɔn no. Na wɔtee nne kɛseɛ bi firi soro a ɛka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Momforo mmra ha! Na wɔforo faa mununkum no mu, na wɔn atamfoɔ no hunuu wɔn. Na ɛdɔn no ara mu asase wosoo kɛse, na kuro no nkyekyɛmu du mu baako hwee ase, na asasewosoɔ no kumm nnipa mpemnson. Na wɔn a ɛkaeɛ no suroe, na wɔhyɛɛ ɔsoro Nyankopɔn animuonyam. Mmusuo a ɛtɔ so mmienu no atwa mu. Hwɛ, Mmusuo a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa reba ntɛm.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nson no hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto. Na ɛnne akɛseɛ gyegyegyegyee soro sɛ:
Wiase ahennie ayɛ yɛn Awurade
ne ne Kristo no dea,
na ɔbɛdi hene daa daa.
Na mpanimfoɔ aduonu nnan a wɔtete wɔn nhennwa soɔ Nyankopɔn anim no de wɔn anim butubutuu fam, na wɔkotoo Onyankopɔn kaa sɛ:
Yɛda wo, Awurade Nyankopɔn, ade nyinaa so Tumfoɔ
a na wowɔ hɔ dada, na wowɔ hɔ no ase,
sɛ woafa wo tumi kɛseɛ,
na woadi hene.
Na amanaman no bo afu,
na w’abufuo ne awufoɔ berɛ no
aduru sɛ wobɛbu atɛn,
na woama wo nkoa, adiyifoɔ
ne ahotefoɔ ne wɔn a wɔsuro wo din,
nketewa ne akɛseɛ no akatua,
na woasɛe wɔn a wɔasɛe asase no.
Na wɔhinii Nyankopɔn asɔredan no ɔsoro, na wɔhunuu n’apam adaka no n’asɔredan no mu. Na anyinam, ne ɛnne, ne aprannaa, ne asasewosoɔ ne asukɔtweaaguo kɛseɛ bae.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
